description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Haunted Mire, adding {G}.
Activate Floral Evoker by paying {G} and discarding Veilborn Ghoul, returning Haunted Mire from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Haunted Mire enters, Floral Evoker and Veilborn Ghoul trigger.
Resolve the Floral Evoker trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Veilborn Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
